name: Suggestion
summary: Suggestion chip strip rendered above PromptInput (or beside an assistant message). One chip click submits the suggestion to the chat handler.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER ship more than 4 suggestion chips. More creates choice paralysis.
NEVER use Spring Green on a Suggestion chip — chips are neutral; the accent appears only on Submit.
NEVER repeat a chip across turns. Suggestions are context-specific, not menu options.
NEVER use Suggestion as a slash-command palette — that's PromptInputTools.
